findings.issue: goto is called with noScroll and keepFocus, options that SvelteKit 3 removed (merged into reset: false). They are silently ignored, so changing the Game select resets scroll and focus instead of preserving them.
findings.suggestion: Use goto(url, { replace: true, reset: false }) per the SvelteKit 3 migration guide.

findings.issue: URL→state sync only runs for popstate; a same-route link navigation to '/' (e.g. the Pokémon nav link) leaves filters applied while the URL shows no filters, desyncing URL and view.
findings.suggestion: Sync from the URL on all navigations within the route (or derive filter state from page.shallow.url ?? page.url instead of one-shot local state).

findings.issue: Module-level promise cache is unbounded for the life of the Node process and getJson has no timeout, so slow/hung API calls pile up and cached payloads accumulate without limit.
findings.suggestion: Add an AbortSignal.timeout to fetch and either an LRU cap or a documented assumption that the dataset bounds the cache.

findings.issue: isMissing and format are duplicated near-identically in MoveTable.svelte:31,92, moves/[name]/+page.svelte:6 and two +page.server.js files.
findings.suggestion: Move both helpers into #lib/format.js next to humanize and import them.

findings.issue: The card component hardcodes its own <li>, so it's only valid as a direct child of a <ul> — a leaky contract that will surprise future reuse (e.g. in a grid of non-list markup).
findings.suggestion: Render only the link and let callers provide list markup, or document the constraint in the component.

findings.issue: {#key data.selectedGame} remounts every MoveTable (and resets their DOM) just to reset sort state when the game changes — the Svelte guidance warns #key is expensive.
findings.suggestion: Reset sort state inside MoveTable via a keyed prop change (e.g. reset sort when table.name/rows identity changes) instead of remounting whole subtrees.

findings.issue: Type colour comes from a dynamic global class type-{name} defined in app.css; an unexpected type name silently renders as Normal with no signal.
findings.suggestion: Keep the fallback but log or assert unknown type names in dev so data/API drift is visible.

summary: This is a well-crafted, genuinely current SvelteKit 3 codebase: v3 vite.config plugin setup, #lib imports, $app/state, runes, snippets, and the new shallow-routing goto API used exactly as documented, with a clean server-only data layer. The only real merge blocker is one removed goto option set (noScroll/keepFocus instead of reset: false) that silently degrades UX on the Pokémon page. I'd approve after one small round of fixes.
